calculation.description: Ranks assets by 60-day price trend, scaled by directional consistency over 40 sessions and annualized downside volatility over the same 40-session window. All inputs are lag-safe and use data through the decision date.

validation.regime_notes: Full-history daily paper ICIR is below the admission threshold, but the benchmark online gate is passed decisively at the 10-session horizon. Positive and strengthening performance is observed online, in 2028, and in 2029. Use as a recent-regime 10-day trend component; uncertainty remains material for a 15-asset cross-section.

provenance.artifact_notes: Script computes cross-sectional rank IC using only historical close data and forward returns; no live account or date state modified.
